input.body:
Dear Mr Mercer,

Thank you for letting us know, and I'm sorry for the repeated reminders. Your wife's call and email from around two weeks ago haven't been linked to this request on our system, which is why the chasers kept going out. We will stop chasing you for the readings.

Our office team is now checking our inbox and call records to find the readings she sent. You don't need to take another reading. If it's easy for you, forwarding her original email to us would help us find it faster, but there's no obligation.

We'll update you by 22 September.

Kind regards,
Northbridge Lettings
14 Brindlefern Walk, Larkmere, ZZ1 1ZZ – ref R/006
